sections.title: A day in the valley
lines: Creatures stand at posts and work: resting at the Bonfire, scouting, smithing at the Forge, trading at the Market.
Drag a creature from the tray onto a place or seat, or tap a seat and pick one. A creature with no post only rests.
Coming back after a few hours is a return walk. The Gazette tells what happened, and everything comes home on its own.
It offers at most one choice: push a scout deeper. There are no timers; creatures that fall behind catch up at the fire.
Friends who are online send their creatures to visit your fire.

sections.title: The commons
lines: Each place has one project for the whole server. Give Acorns, scrap and shards; the Market's takes shards of any kind.
A full project takes a few build days, then the place levels up: more seats and anvils, a plaque of helpers, a keepsake.
Build the hearth, then the Market, then the Forge, then the rest. Give early: the commons unlock everything.
Collections and keystones are goals for the whole server too.

sections.title: The Forge
lines: Tap the Forge to open the workshop. Each anvil has a smith: give it orders for what to make, or it tinkers on its own.
Buy the next anvil from the dashed outline. Finished pieces pile up on its floor; a full floor pauses that anvil.
On your next arrival, common pieces come home by themselves. One made for your team is worn; the rest go to the bag.
Rare and epic pieces wait in the sealed crate. Open it to reveal them one by one, best last. It never pauses an anvil.
Patchwork pieces take shards of any kind.

sections.title: Gear
lines: Any creature wears any item, and every slot is open from level 1.
The Forge's fire sets the item level of new pieces. Master titles, boss kills and the commons warm it.
A Common has one line, a Rare two and an Epic three. The pips show how well a line rolled.
Some lines depend on where a creature stands, fire by chance or react in a fight. Set pieces give a bonus worn together.

sections.title: The Market and the visitor
lines: Shards are exchanged only at the Market, once the server has built it. A broker seat swaps spare shards for you.
The visitor is here from Thursday to the end of Sunday and rerolls all lines of one piece for Acorns and scrap.
A reroll keeps the piece's rarity and item level, and each reroll that week costs more.
The visitor also sells one blueprint a week, for Acorns and shards of any kind.

sections.title: The School and trials
lines: A teacher visits from Monday to Wednesday, announced on Friday. Send the creatures that can learn the talent.
They learn it by the next morning and it enters your book. Learning on a card costs Acorns; the born talent is free.
Trials are Bronze from level 10, Silver from 20 and Gold from 30. Each has a combat feat and boxes from the valley.
Creatures graduate at the School's daily ceremony in the evening, even when you are away.
An honour is a title, a badge and a ribbon on the sprite. It gives no stats and gates nothing.
